title: Lab - Cluster roles
scenario: Grant cluster-wide permissions. This lab is a skeleton: the tasks name what to do and how to check it; work them on your own cluster and expand your notes as you go.
environment_setup:
# A three-node kind cluster is enough for this lab
cat <<'EOF' > kind-cka.yaml
kind: Cluster
apiVersion: kind.x-k8s.io/v1alpha4
name: cka
nodes:
  - role: control-plane
  - role: worker
  - role: worker
EOF
kind create cluster --config kind-cka.yaml
kubectl get nodes
cleanup:
kind delete cluster --name cka
rm -f kind-cka.yaml

tasks.title: Task 1 - Count
tasks.instructions: How many ClusterRoles and ClusterRoleBindings exist?
tasks.solution:
kubectl get clusterroles --no-headers | wc -l
kubectl get clusterrolebindings --no-headers | wc -l

tasks.title: Task 2 - Nodes
tasks.instructions: Grant user michelle permission to list and watch nodes.
tasks.solution:
kubectl create clusterrole node-admin --verb=get,list,watch --resource=nodes
kubectl create clusterrolebinding michelle-binding --clusterrole=node-admin --user=michelle
tasks.verification: kubectl auth can-i list nodes --as michelle

tasks.title: Task 3 - Storage
tasks.instructions: Grant michelle full rights on PersistentVolumes and StorageClasses.
tasks.solution:
kubectl create clusterrole storage-admin --verb=* --resource=persistentvolumes,storageclasses
kubectl create clusterrolebinding michelle-storage-admin --clusterrole=storage-admin --user=michelle
tasks.verification: kubectl auth can-i create storageclasses --as michelle
